cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama District 4 since 2018 and Senate President Pro Tempore since February 2025. Owner of Southern Accents Architectural Antiques in Cullman. Served on the Cullman City Council 2004-2018, the last ten years as its president.
cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions from Gudger on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or foreign land buyers, growth and land conservation, police pay, gun laws, or school choice and teacher pay. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026, and he did not complete its candidate survey. The sources do not say whether he moved within Alabama. A Wikipedia page says he supports Alabama's abortion ban, but it gives no specific vote or bill, so that is not included as a deed.
